description: 托盘装柜（Pallet loading）：一个柜装多少托、多少箱：填托盘、箱子、限高和柜型，看俯视图。 Pallets and cartons per container: enter the pallet, carton, height limit and container, and see the floor plan. 读取数据 / Reads: containers@current. 输入为精确的十进制字符串 / Inputs are exact decimal strings. 用户没有给的数字和日期不要自己编：必填的先问用户，选填的不填。 / Never make up a figure or a date the user did not give: ask for a required one, leave an optional one out. 回复时引用回答里的 provenance.source_line / Quote provenance.source_line in your reply. 结果仅供计算参考，不是税务、法律或投资意见；回答时请带上返回的说明和来源行。 / The result is for calculation and reference only, not tax, legal or investment advice; when you answer, pass on the returned notice and source line.

inputSchema.description: 数字最好写成字符串（十进制，如 "12.5"），JSON 数字也行；千位逗号只认 1,234,567 这种写法，小数点用英文句点，不要带货币符号或单位。币种可写 USD、usd 或 美元，单位可写 cm 或 厘米，日期可写 2026-05-01、2026/05/01 或 20260501。读不准的一律拒绝并说明原因，绝不猜；回答里的 normalized 列出实际采用的值。 / Figures should be sent as decimal strings such as "12.5"; a JSON number is accepted too. A thousands comma only as 1,234,567; the decimal point is a dot; no currency symbols or units. A currency may be USD, usd or 美元, a unit cm or 厘米, a date 2026-05-01, 2026/05/01 or 20260501. Anything that cannot be read in exactly one way is refused with a reason, never guessed; `normalized` in the answer lists what was used.

cartonsPerLayer.description: 每层箱数（自己填，要和层数一起） / Cartons per layer (your own figure, with the layers)

doorHeight.description: 柜门高（可改参考值） / Door height (replaces the reference value)

grossWeight.description: 每箱毛重 / Gross weight per carton

height.description: 箱高（朝上的一边） / Carton height (the side marked up)

insideHeight.description: 柜内高（可改参考值） / Inside height (replaces the reference value)

insideLength.description: 柜内长（可改参考值） / Inside length (replaces the reference value)

insideWidth.description: 柜内宽（可改参考值） / Inside width (replaces the reference value)

layerCount.description: 层数（自己填，要和每层箱数一起） / Layers (your own figure, with the cartons per layer)

lengthUnit.description: 尺寸单位。可选值：cm = cm；mm = mm；in = in / Size unit. options: cm = cm; mm = mm; in = in

maxHeight.description: 限高（含托盘） / Height limit (pallet included)

orientation.description: 托盘摆法。可选值：auto = 自动取托数多的；a = A：托盘长边沿柜长；b = B：托盘短边沿柜长 / Pallet direction. options: auto = Automatic (the one with more places); a = A: long side along the container; b = B: short side along the container

payload.description: 最大载重（可改参考值） / Maximum payload (replaces the reference value)

stack.description: 托盘叠放。可选值：1 = 不叠放；2 = 叠 2 层 / Stacking pallets. options: 1 = Not stacked; 2 = Stack 2 high

weightUnit.description: 重量单位。可选值：kg = kg；lb = lb / Weight unit. options: kg = kg; lb = lb

name: pallet-load

Links.description: Addresses that go with the answer. `page`: the tool’s page on the site with the same inputs in its address, in the language asked (Chinese for a language the site does not publish yet), so a person can open the page that shows these numbers.

page.description: The tool’s page holding these inputs.

Normalized.description: What the API changed in the inputs before core saw them, so the caller sees what was understood: a JSON number as text, a thousands comma, full-width digits, a currency or unit name or a date written another way. Absent when nothing was changed.

PlainValue.description: A figure, tagged so a reader knows how to write it: amounts and quantities are exact decimal strings, never floats.

places.description: How many decimal places the rounding rule keeps; pad to it, never round.
How many decimal places of the fraction the rounding rule keeps; write the percentage padded to two fewer (0.2820 is 28.20 %), never round.

value.description: A token from a fixed list the tool exports; the words for it are the copy key `<tool>.code.<value>`.
A number that is data, such as a barcode number: write it as it is, keep its leading zeros, never group it.

Provenance.description: Where the figures in an answer come from. In every answer, errors included.

language.description: The language of the source lines.

license.description: The license as copy keys: which text applies. `status` was `draft` until the text was approved (2026-10-12) and is `approved` now.

notice.description: 本站非官方渠道的说明：引用本站数据时请和来源行一起转述。 / The site’s own line that it is not an official channel: pass it on with the source line when you quote us.

site.description: The site the data is published by.

source_line.description: 来源行：回复用户时请原样引用它，让读者知道数据出自哪里、有多新。 / The credit line to quote as it is when you answer: who the figures come from and how fresh they are (the newest publisher’s day among the datasets used, or the day the answer was made).

ProvenanceDataset.description: A dataset version an answer drew on. An origin the register does not let the site show is named nowhere.

amended_by.description: The official notices whose changes this version carries on top of its edition, where there are any: each one by its number and title as the notice writes them and its own date (no page is given). The label a reader sees is the edition and these, for example 2026B + 公告2026年第29号.

edition.description: The publisher’s name for the edition (2026B), where it names them.

origin.description: The origin’s id in the register; null when the site may not show it.

published_at.description: The publisher’s own date (and time, with its offset, when it gives one).

source.description: The publisher’s own source line, in the answer’s language; null when there is none to show.

source_url.description: The publisher’s page, only where the register lets the site link to it.

version.description: Its version, named after the publisher’s date.

Step.description: One line of the worked example: `id` is the copy key of its sentence, `values` fill it in.

message.description: 这一步的一句话说明，数值已代入，用请求的语言。 / The step as one sentence in the language asked, its figures filled in. Absent when a sentence cannot be made whole.

Warning.description: Something a reader should know about a result; `code` is a copy key.

message.description: 这条提醒的一句话说明，数值已代入，用请求的语言：回复时请用它，不要自己编数字。 / The warning as one sentence in the language asked, its figures filled in: use it, do not make up figures. Absent when a sentence cannot be made whole.

next.description: For a hint: the slug of the tool it points to.

pallet_loadOutputs.description: Each figure core returns, by id, as a tagged value. The ids listed are the ones the tool’s manifest names; a tool may return more (a figure that only its worked steps use), in the same form.
